content:
DIGITALbuilt is a European Digital Innovation Hub (EDIH) that unites three clusters on the theme of the Built Environment: Architecture, Engineering and Construction, Mineral Resources and Railway. This EDIH provides SMEs and public administration organisations with services such as: Digital transformation, Capacity building, Digital inclusion, Support in finding finance and intermediation, SME incubation services , Digital maturity diagnostics.

Its aim is to help increase the competitiveness, sustainability and efficiency of the sectors targeted, through digital training and inclusion of the built environment agents involved in the construction, mineral resources and railway sectors and the digital transformation of the SMEs and public administration bodies involved.

Objectives

The DIGITALbuilt Project is structured in 4 interrelated Work Packages, which together will contribute to the capacity building and digital transformation of SMEs and public administration bodies and the final provision and execution of a list of services that meet the needs of the industry.

WP1 ‘Management and Coordination’ is dedicated to project management.
As part of WP2 ‘Needs Diagnostic’, a study will be carried out to identify the needs of companies in the project sectors.
WP3 ‘Provided services’ will define the needs of SMEs and public administration bodies.
Finally, WP4 ‘Dissemination and Communication’ is dedicated to disseminating and communicating the project.
